entries.en: We need to stop the Holy Grail from[n]healing. Should I send someone...?
entries.uk: Треба завадити Святому Граалю[n]лікуватися. Відправити когось...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm gonna give those red things a good[n]slice!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I got this! Just keep attackin' him so he[n]doesn't see me!
entries.uk: Я впораюся! Просто атакуйте його,[n]щоб він мене не помітив!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Understood! Make sure you draw his[n]attention with your attacks!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The... supply lines, right? We gotta[n]cut them!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Beat him up while I'm on my way![n]That'll keep him from seeing me!
entries.uk: Лупцюйте його, поки я йду![n]Тоді він мене не помітить!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: First, we must deal with those red[n]supply lines.
entries.uk: Спершу треба розібратися з тими[n]червоними магістралями.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will do this. Allow me!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Draw his attention. Be sure not to[n]cease your attacks.
entries.uk: Відволікайте його увагу. Неодмінно[n]атакуйте без упину.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Cutting the supply lines is our utmost[n]priority...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You want me? I can do it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Keep his gaze on you, okay? Don't stop[n]attacking him.
entries.uk: Тримайте його погляд на собі, гаразд?[n]Не припиняйте атакувати.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We need to sever the supply lines,[n]correct?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Just make sure you attack him so his[n]attention is drawn to you!
entries.uk: Тільки неодмінно атакуйте його, щоб[n]він дивився на вас!
